visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women wearing matching sleeveless red evening gowns with high side slits stand side-by-side in a luxurious indoor hallway. The woman on the left holds a silver transverse flute to her lips, and the woman on the right holds a wooden violin and bow. A small square inset video above them displays rapidly changing anime clips and title cards. (2) Both women perform their instruments with focused but smiling expressions. The flutist moves her fingers across the keys, and the violinist draws her bow across the strings in a rhythmic fashion. The setting features polished stone walls, warm lighting, and a glass-enclosed interior in the background. (3) Around the midpoint, they lower their instruments and transition into a synchronized dance. They cross their arms over their chests and sway their hips to the beat while looking directly at the camera with bright smiles. Their movements are precise and coordinated, emphasizing the upbeat energy of the scene.
